_note: Two people. A lives the moments, B shows the way. Both voices are dry (no room echo) and a little slower than normal. `say` is how the voice reads a line; `pause` is extra frames of silence after it. A line's `os` gives what it says in the Mac or Linux cut instead.

hook.text: How many times a day do you grab your phone, just to scan something that's already on your laptop?

reveal.text: Keep the phone down. There's a faster way.

platforms.text: Windows, Mac, or Linux. And the hotkey is yours to change.

class.text: Windows key, Shift, Q. It's copied.

call.text: Each one gets a number. Pick one.

monitors.text: It scans every screen at once.

scam.text: My package is on hold? Scan to pay?
Look at the card. That link really goes somewhere else.

real.text: That's the actual app, recorded on Windows.

outro.text: It's free and open source. Try it out.
